summary.text: Chuck Hand is the Republican candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Chuck Hand was born in Columbus, Georgia, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a construction superintendent.

Ballotpedia lists him as a Republican candidate for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District in 2024, when he and A. Wayne Johnson advanced to a runoff from the May 21 primary and Johnson won the June 18 runoff.
Ballotpedia also lists him among the candidates for the 2026 Republican primary in the same congressional district who did not appear on the ballot.
